1836246dfbfb504c.text: Introduction Understanding why green innovation diffuses unevenly across firm populations requires a model that separates the structure of firms’ knowledge from the networks through which they learn. Methods We develop an agent-based model in which heterogeneous firms search a dual-dimensional NK landscape comprising conventional and green knowledge, acquire external knowledge through a learning network constructed relative to a competition-reference topology, and respond to carbon pricing, green R&D subsidies, and targeted learning-edge additions. The cross-domain parameter C specifies a one-way dependence of green fitness contributions on conventional knowledge. We distinguish firm-level adoption, system transition, and persistent lock-in, report uncertainty using 100 replications for ordinary conditions and 500 for focal lock-in estimates, and distinguish implementation verification, conceptual and structural validation, literature-grounded qualitative pattern comparison, and the limits of predictive validation. Results In 100-replication Monte Carlo experiments, final mean green fitness under a carbon tax falls from 0.713 at C = 0 to 0.614 at C = 5 , while the final firm-level adoption rate, defined by a green-fitness threshold, falls from 0.941 to 0.762. Homogeneous-behaviour and mechanism-ablation benchmarks show that behavioural heterogeneity materially changes aggregate and cross-firm outcomes, internal search accounts for most of the tax response, and imitation can also propagate comparatively weak knowledge configurations. Carbon pricing is the most consistently effective single instrument. Targeted bridge addition has little effect without an incentive change and yields only a small, knowledge-structure-dependent incremental effect when combined with taxation. Discussion The diagnostics are consistent with contextual revaluation of green configurations and changes in the conversion of search proposals into implemented improvements, without separating their contributions to the aggregate decline. Because the model is stylised rather than industry calibrated, its policy results are interpreted as conditional mechanism evidence rather than sector-level predictions.
1836246dfbfb504c.abstract_zh:
研究的问题是绿色创新为何在企业群体中扩散不均。作者认为需要把企业的知识结构和学习网络分开建模。模型中，异质性企业在由常规知识和绿色知识构成的双维 NK 地形上搜索，通过一个相对竞争参照拓扑构建的学习网络获取外部知识，并响应碳定价、绿色研发补贴和定向添加学习边三种干预。跨域参数 C 刻画绿色适应度对常规知识的单向依赖。结果层面区分了企业级采纳、系统转型和持续锁定三种状态，普通条件做 100 次重复、锁定估计做 500 次重复来报告不确定性，并区分了实现验证、概念与结构验证、基于文献的定性模式比较，以及预测性验证的局限。

100 次重复的蒙特卡洛实验中，碳税下最终平均绿色适应度从 C=0 时的 0.713 降到 C=5 时的 0.614，按绿色适应度阈值定义的企业采纳率从 0.941 降到 0.762。同质行为基准和机制消融实验表明，行为异质性显著改变总量和企业间结果，内部搜索贡献了碳税响应的大部分，模仿也会传播相对较弱的知识构型。碳定价是最稳定有效的单一工具；定向添加网络桥梁在不改变激励时几乎没有效果，与税收结合时也只有依赖知识结构的小幅增量。

诊断结果与绿色构型的情境性重估以及搜索提议转化为实际改进的比率变化相一致，但模型没有分离二者对总量下降的贡献。模型是风格化的，没有按行业校准，因此政策结果被解释为条件性的机制证据，而非行业层面的预测。
1836246dfbfb504c.why: 它把知识结构（双维 NK 地形）和学习网络分开建模，用消融实验量化了行为异质性和内部搜索对政策响应的贡献，对做政策推演的人是一个提醒：网络干预若不配合激励，效果有限。

1601caa884a2ecff.text: Deterrence is a cornerstone of military strategy, yet its theoretical foundations, particularly the conflicting predictions of classical deterrence theory and perfect deterrence theory, lack the empirical validation required to develop effective AI-enabled decision aids. To address this limitation, we propose using experimental methods, primarily the mutual deterrence game (MDG), to rigorously test theoretical predictions and investigate how psychosocial factors like risk aversion and strategic reasoning (k-level thinking) influence human deterrence decisions. We also advocate leveraging the resulting empirical insights to inform the development of AI tools. We demonstrate through simulation that a reinforcement learning (RL) agent in an iterated MDG can successfully learn an adversary's preferences such as aversion to inequity, challenger gains or defender losses to model escalatory behaviour over time. Recognizing the limitations and inherent escalatory biases of autonomous AI, we contend that a human–machine co-learning framework is the most effective implementation. In this model, humans and AI, including RL and large language models, work interdependently to update beliefs, generate courses of action and model adversarial intent. This integrated research programme provides the necessary theoretical and technical architecture for creating advanced AI-enabled decision aids that can help policy-makers reduce the likelihood of conflict.

1413a4ddc72a2582.text: LLM-based user simulators aim to bridge the offline-online gap in recommender evaluation by emulating users through injected traits, where preference attributes determine what a user engages with and a behavioral activity trait governs how long they browse. However, we show this intended trait independence collapses during simulation, causing two failures: (i) Trait Interference, where amplified activity distorts preference boundaries and forces interactions with mismatched items to sustain browsing, and (ii) Evaluation Invalidity, where satisfaction scores inflate with activity-driven page counts despite taste mismatches, biasing evaluation toward trait distributions rather than recommender performance. To resolve this, we propose PQA, a page-level quality anchoring method that guides simulators using a personalized anchor reflecting each user's intrinsic preference standard. By assessing whether a page meets this standard before further browsing, PQA enables proactive exits from low-quality pages, letting the activity trait retain its intended role of modulating browsing depth within preference-conforming pages. Experiments show PQA mitigates trait interference and improves the reliability of LLM-based simulator evaluation under activity shifts. Our code is available at https://github.com/chaehyun1/PQA

147e4be29034a8b1.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as user simulators, yet it remains unclear whether their predictions faithfully reproduce the evolving decisions of individual users. We investigate this question in a controlled longitudinal paper-trading study with 80 participants, where user interactions, simulated transactions, virtual portfolio states, and point-in-time market information are aligned under a rolling next-day prediction protocol. We evaluate behavioral fidelity hierarchically, from trade occurrence to action structure, asset selection, and downstream portfolio consequences. Across 1,239 aligned user-days, no evaluated LLM reliably outperforms a simple recent-activity persistence baseline for predicting whether a user trades. Fidelity further deteriorates at finer levels: models struggle to recover buy--sell structure and traded assets, and similar activity-level predictions can lead to substantially different portfolio trajectories. Controlled evidence ablations show that recent trading history strongly governs activity prediction, whereas asset selection is substantially more sensitive to the available evidence. An observational analysis further finds that intensified ticker-specific research predicts imminent trading, but diagnostic tests do not support a causal interpretation. These findings suggest that current LLMs capture useful short-term behavioral regularities without yet recovering a stable individual decision mechanism.
147e4be29034a8b1.abstract_zh: LLM 越来越多地被当作用户模拟器使用，但它们能否忠实复现单个用户不断演化的决策，一直没有严格检验。作者设计了一项受控的纵向纸面交易（paper-trading）研究，招募80名参与者，把用户交互记录、模拟交易、虚拟组合状态和按时间对齐的市场信息统一对齐，采用滚动式次日预测协议来评测。行为保真度按层级评估，从是否发生交易，到动作结构、资产选择，再到下游组合结果。在1,239个对齐的用户日上，没有任何被测 LLM 在预测用户是否交易这一点上稳定超过一个简单的“近期行为延续”基线。越往细粒度走，保真度越差：模型难以还原买卖结构和所交易的资产，而且活动层面的相似预测可能导向差异很大的组合轨迹。受控的证据消融显示，近期交易历史强烈主导活动预测，而资产选择对可用证据要敏感得多。观察性分析还发现，针对特定股票的研究强度上升预示着即将交易，但诊断检验不支持因果解释。这些发现说明，当前 LLM 能捕捉有用的短期行为规律，但还没有恢复出稳定的个体决策机制。材料未说明具体测试了哪些模型。
147e4be29034a8b1.why: 这是少见的用受控纵向真人实验检验 LLM 用户模拟保真度的工作，给出了“LLM 模拟器跑不赢简单基线”的反例，对任何想用 LLM 做市场或用户仿真的研究者都是一剂清醒剂。

brief.question: LLM 作为用户模拟器，能否忠实复现单个投资者在滚动纸面交易（paper-trading）中的逐日决策，包括是否交易、买卖结构、资产选择和组合结果。

brief.method: 分层评估行为保真度，从交易发生到动作结构、资产选择、再到下游组合轨迹；并做受控证据消融，区分近期交易历史与可用证据对活动预测和资产选择的影响。

brief.validation: 与 80 名真实参与者的纵向交易数据对齐比较，并做了受控证据消融和因果诊断检验；材料未说明具体误差数字。

brief.reuse: 滚动次日预测协议、分层保真度评估框架（活动、结构、资产、组合后果）和证据消融设计可复用；代码数据是否公开材料未说明。

18e57d3f4a25e11c.text: Large Language models (LLMs), having been trained on vast amounts of human-generated data, may encode the opinions, attitudes, and behaviors of these humans. As such, LLMs show promise in mimicking human-like patterns that facilitate their use in simulating people in a wide variety of contexts. One such context is using LLMs as 'silicon samples', i.e., proxies of people in answering survey questions to establish public opinion, design policies, or use as (social) scientific data. However, several critical questions of social biases, generalization, and technical limitations remain, further complicated by a vast design space open to simulation designers. In addition, LLM-simulated surveys often lean on existing survey infrastructure, e.g., survey questions and samples. These artifacts might not be suitable for LLMs or themselves might have errors that are then inherited by the LLM-powered survey simulations. As a result, we lack a systematic understanding of the design space of LLM-generated surveys as well as how these decisions interplay with inherent LLM limitations. In this article, we aim to systematically identify, trace, and document limitations in LLM-generated survey responses. Building on traditions in the quantitative social sciences, specifically survey methodology and measurement theory, we investigate threats to the validity of LLM-generated survey responses. To do so, we design a framework that enumerates conceptual errors and systematic biases that can occur at different stages of the survey simulation lifecycle. Our framework - called the Total Simulated Survey Error (TS2E) Framework - provides a unified and end-to-end perspective on errors in LLM-generated survey data. We illustrate the framework through a theoretical and empirical case study, which enables survey simulation designers to systematically understand, identify and reflect on errors in LLM-generated surveys.
18e57d3f4a25e11c.abstract_zh:
大模型在海量人类数据上训练，可能编码了人类的观点、态度和行为，因此有希望充当“硅基样本”，代替真人回答问卷，用于测量公众意见、设计政策或作为社会科学数据。但社会偏见、泛化能力和技术局限等问题仍未解决，而且仿真设计空间庞大，设计者的各种选择会相互影响。此外，大模型问卷仿真通常沿用现成的调查基础设施，比如已有的问卷题目和样本。这些工具本身可能不适合大模型，也可能自带误差，误差会随之被继承到仿真结果里。作者指出，目前学界对大模型生成问卷的设计空间，以及这些设计决策与大模型固有局限之间的相互作用，缺乏系统理解。

做法上，作者从定量社会科学的调查方法学和测量理论出发，设计了一个框架，把问卷仿真生命周期不同阶段可能出现的概念性错误和系统性偏差逐一枚举和追踪，命名为 Total Simulated Survey Error（TS2E）框架。这个框架提供了对大模型生成问卷数据误差的端到端统一视角。

作者通过一个理论和实证结合的案例研究来展示框架的用法，让问卷仿真设计者能够系统地理解、识别和反思大模型生成问卷中的误差。材料未给出案例的具体数据和量化结果。
18e57d3f4a25e11c.why: 它把传统调查方法学里的误差框架移植到大模型仿真问卷上，给做合成样本和人类行为仿真的研究者提供了一份可对照检查的误差清单，是评估仿真可信度时可以直接复用的工具。

1f600c3be006cda4.text: Cumulative culture enables humans to preserve, reuse, and extend knowledge and skills across experiences and generations. Inspired by this principle, we introduce \textit{SimSkill}, a self-evolving agent built around the Simulation of Urban MObility (SUMO) traffic simulator. SimSkill continually identifies capability gaps, generates and solves environment-grounded tasks, verifies solutions through an action--critic loop, and consolidates experience into episodic, procedural, and semantic memory. Through autonomous exploration, it builds a library of reusable skills and knowledge spanning major stages of the traffic-simulation workflow. We evaluate SimSkill on two held-out benchmarks across three backbone LLMs, with each result independently verified. It improves verified success by up to 25 percentage points, and ablations show complementary contributions from procedural and semantic memory. Its benefits remain backbone- and budget-dependent, as memory does not improve every model or uniformly reduce inference cost. More broadly, SimSkill illustrates a natural-language-centered design paradigm for LLM-based agent systems. Its high-level control logic, operating principles, and accumulated knowledge are expressed in natural language, while an LLM integrates them with executable tools and code to realize precise and reproducible execution. All code and experimental data are publicly available at https://github.com/qiliuchn/SimSkill-V1.

12180247f6a5d271.text: Large language models can produce locally plausible social turns, but fluent next-turn generation is not enough for social simulation. Human encounters such as restaurant lunches and hotel check-ins are bounded social episodes with roles, scripts, material state, obligations, commitments, timing, and closure conditions. We present EpisodeSim, a hybrid LLM-agent architecture that represents classic-AI structures as natural-language control state interpreted by LLM calls. A World Master maintains shared reality, constructs scenes, adjudicates proposed actions, tracks effects and obligations, and controls closure. Experiments with small qualitative ablations on two held-out settings support a design claim: LLM fluency supplies local texture, but coherent social simulation benefits from persistent classic-AI-style scaffolding that organizes behavior over time.
12180247f6a5d271.abstract_zh: 作者指出，大语言模型能生成局部合理的社交对话回合，但只靠流畅的下一句生成做不了社会仿真。像餐厅午餐、酒店入住这类人类交往是有边界的社交片段，包含角色、脚本、物质状态、义务、承诺、时机和闭合条件。EpisodeSim 把这些经典 AI 结构表示成自然语言形式的控制状态，再由 LLM 调用来解释执行。架构中有一个 World Master，负责维护共享现实、构建场景、裁决智能体提出的动作、追踪效果与义务，并控制片段何时结束。作者在两个留出场景上做了小规模定性消融实验，结果支持其设计主张：LLM 的流畅性提供局部细节，而要得到随时间连贯的社会模拟，需要持久的经典 AI 式脚手架来组织行为。实验规模小且以定性为主，这是材料中可见的局限。
12180247f6a5d271.why: 它给做社会仿真的研究者一个可复用的架构思路：用自然语言承载经典 AI 的状态与控制结构，把 LLM 的局部生成能力框进有边界的社交片段里，而不是放任自由生成。

12e01c2583b1406c.text: World models have recently achieved impressive progress in visual prediction and interactive generation, but extending them to multi-agent environments introduces a fundamental scalability challenge. Existing methods generally assume a fixed number of agents during training and inference, which ties the model to a pre-determined agent population and limits inference-time scalability. Our key insight is that cross-view consistency should arise from a shared world state whose evolution does not assume a predefined number of agents, while agent-specific observations should be generated by querying this state through a unified rendering interface. Based on this insight, we propose Khora, a scalable multi-agent world model that supports inference-time expansion to arbitrary numbers of agents without retraining. Our framework decouples world-state evolution from visual rendering and introduces a population-agnostic rendering mechanism for incorporating other agent information. This design maintains cross-view consistency through the shared world state rather than through dense interactions among observation streams inside the expensive video generator, enabling approximately linear practical scaling with the number of queried views. Qualitative experiments demonstrate that our approach generalizes to unseen numbers of agents while maintaining visual quality and multi-agent consistency. We further implement a real-time interactive system to demonstrate scalable open-world simulation.

1c9556dec7157d23.text: Economic World Models (EWMs) are generative economic models that simulate how economies evolve from within by modeling heterogeneous agents, their beliefs and actions, and the market and institutional mechanisms through which their interactions produce aggregate outcomes. This paper develops an implementation roadmap for building economic world models as generative engines in which heterogeneous agents act, interact, adapt, and co-evolve with markets and institutions, thereby producing economic dynamics from the inside. We organize EWM systems into a six-level capability ladder, from fixed rule-based agent worlds to adaptive and LLM-based agent worlds, self-evolving agents, evolving institutional worlds, and sim-to-real economic twins aligned with real observations. A systematic literature survey across these levels reveals that existing work remains concentrated in lower-level agent and simulation environments, while systems with self-evolving agents, endogenous institutions, persistent empirical alignment, and validated economic mechanisms remain rare. By translating the EWM agenda into an implementation blueprint, this paper aims to accelerate the development of the next generation of economic simulation environments that can serve as high-fidelity sandboxes for human decision-makers and as training, planning, evaluation, and safety substrates for AI agents. We release a curated paper list and related resources to support future research.
1c9556dec7157d23.abstract_zh: 经济世界模型（EWM）是一类生成式经济模型，通过建模异质智能体及其信念与行为，以及市场和制度机制，让经济动态从内部自发生长出来，而不是靠外部设定。这篇论文给出把 EWM 建成生成式引擎的实施路线图，其中异质智能体行动、互动、适应，并与市场和制度共同演化。作者把 EWM 系统组织成六级能力阶梯：从固定规则的智能体世界，到自适应和基于 LLM 的智能体世界，再到自我演化智能体、演化中的制度世界，最后是与真实观测对齐的仿真到真实经济孪生。跨层级的系统文献调研显示，现有工作仍集中在较低层级的智能体和仿真环境，具备自我演化智能体、内生制度、持续经验对齐和经过验证的经济机制的系统很少见。作者希望通过把 EWM 议程翻译成实施蓝图，加速下一代经济仿真环境的开发，这类环境既可作为人类决策者的高保真沙盘，也可作为 AI 智能体的训练、规划、评估和安全基底。论文发布了精选论文列表和相关资源以支持后续研究。材料未说明具体的验证实验细节。
1c9556dec7157d23.why: 它为做经济仿真的研究者提供了一张清晰的能力分级地图和实施路线图，能用来定位自己工作的层级、发现空白方向，附带的精选论文列表也是可复用的资源。

brief.question: 要解决什么问题：如何把 Economic World Models（EWM，经济世界模型）从概念变成可落地的实现路线图，让仿真经济能从内部生成动态，而不是只做外生推演。
brief.setup: 这是一篇立场/综述型论文，不涉及具体仿真实验。材料提出一个六级能力阶梯，从固定规则智能体世界到 LLM 智能体世界、自进化智能体、内生制度演化，再到与真实观测对齐的 sim-to-real 经济孪生。智能体数量、环境细节、时间尺度和所用模型均未说明。
brief.method: 把 EWM 系统组织成六级能力阶梯，并对各层级做系统性文献调研，据此翻译成一份实现蓝图（implementation blueprint）。
brief.findings: 文献调研显示现有工作集中在较低层级的智能体和仿真环境，具备自进化智能体、内生制度、持续经验对齐和经过验证的经济机制的系统仍然稀少。论文主张 EWM 可作为人类决策者的高保真沙盘，以及 AI 智能体的训练、规划、评估和安全基底。
brief.validation: 未说明。材料只提到做了系统性文献调研，没有与真实数据对比或消融实验。
brief.limits: 未说明。材料本身指出该领域缺乏自进化智能体和经验对齐系统，可视为现状层面的局限。
brief.reuse: 论文发布了精选论文列表和相关资源（curated paper list），可用于后续研究。代码和数据未说明。

1779912892e0accc.text: Agent-based models (ABMs) are difficult to reproduce: their behavior is spread across prose narratives, platform-specific code, and implicit assumptions, so that two readers routinely reconstruct different models from the same documentation. We present VISA, a structured, symbol-based description protocol that specifies a model in eight interconnected tables---four at the agent level (Agent, Variable, Sensing, Internal Function) and four at the model level (Associated Data, Input/Output, Schedule, Validation)---under the principle of minimality with completeness. VISA makes a model machine-parseable and unambiguous via two artifacts: nineteen executable consistency rules that turn model validity into a checkable property, and three reusable LLM-executable skills (authoring, checking, and code generation) that operationalize the full author--check--code--reproduce loop. We validate the protocol on three external, independently authored ABMs spanning three platforms: we reproduce two cross-language (NetLogo to Python) directly from their VISA specifications, and we capture a third, an industrial AnyLogic model, in eight tables (passing all nineteen rules) while honestly demarcating where reproduction is blocked by a proprietary movement library and unavailable data---itself a transparency contribution. VISA moves the reproduction barrier from the model, where it is invisible, to a named, localized dependency, where it is actionable.

1c3b26dbd944d5b2.text: Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT), as a key technology for personalized education, aims to accurately assess examinee proficiency by retrieving exercises dynamically matching current ability estimates. However, existing CAT research is constrained by limitations of static offline data and isolated component optimization. Restricted by partial labels in offline logs, researchers degrade the dynamic assessment process into static sequence prediction. Current research focuses on isolated perspectives, e.g., selection or diagnosis, neglecting the overall CAT interaction process. To address this, we propose AgentCAT, a Large Language Model-based multi-agent simulation system, to construct a high-fidelity benchmarking environment for dynamic testing. This framework comprises three modules: (1) The examinee agent with memory retrieval and Chain-of-Thought reasoning simulates responses based on cognitive profiles; (2) The selection agent uses coarse-to-fine bucketing and knowledge graph exploration to balance local difficulty and global coverage; (3) The supervisor uses dual-auditing and robust update to ensure convergence and validity. To validate the framework, we evaluated on two real-world datasets across three dimensions: macro-level ability convergence, micro-level interaction logic, and data sparsity resilience. Results show AgentCAT achieves effective ability estimation, and its selection strategy balances difficulty adaptation and instructional coherence, aligning with human pedagogical intuition.

1465a55bff71e654.text: Closed-loop driving simulators mostly fill their environments with traffic agents that behave alike, whether they are rule-based or learned. Recent methods that control driving style learn it from labels inferred from existing driving recordings, from synthetic data generated to reflect each style, or from reward weights estimated by a large language model (LLM). All of these are indirect estimates of a style, not recordings of people who were instructed to drive in it. We introduce PersonaDrive, a vision-language-action (VLA) driving agent that takes its style from retrieved human demonstrations. The demonstrations come from a new dataset in which 15 participants drove CARLA routes on a driving simulator under conservative, neutral, and aggressive instructions. PersonaDrive trains a lightweight retrieval head on features from a frozen image encoder and on control signals over per-style databases, and fine-tunes one VLA backbone over the retrieved demonstrations. Switching style only means searching a different FAISS index, with no retraining. On the Bench2Drive benchmark without style conditioning, PersonaDrive improves the Driving Score by 4.6% over SimLingo and by 2.5% over HiP-AD, a gain that fine-tuning without retrieval does not reproduce. With style conditioning, PersonaDrive outperforms the strongest baseline, Drive My Way, in every style, with a Driving Score 6.7% to 11.6% higher. Its driving also follows the instruction, since average speed rises by 19.8% from the conservative to the aggressive style. Each traffic agent is evaluated individually as a driving policy. The dataset and model weights are available on the project page: https://pervasiveautonomylab.github.io/personadrive-landpage/.
1465a55bff71e654.abstract_zh: 闭环驾驶仿真器里的交通智能体大多行为雷同，无论规则式还是学习式。现有控制驾驶风格的方法要么从已有驾驶录像推断的标签学风格，要么用合成数据，要么让大语言模型估计奖励权重，这些都是对风格的间接估计，而不是让人按指定风格开车录下来的数据。PersonaDrive 改用真人演示：15 名参与者在驾驶模拟器上按保守、中性、激进三种指令驾驶 CARLA 路线，构成一个新数据集。模型方面，作者在冻结的图像编码器特征和控制信号上训练一个轻量检索头，按风格分别建 FAISS 索引，再用检索到的演示微调一个 VLA 骨干网络。切换风格只需换一个 FAISS 索引，不用重新训练。在 Bench2Drive 基准上，不做风格条件时，PersonaDrive 的驾驶分数比 SimLingo 高 4.6%，比 HiP-AD 高 2.5%，而且这个提升是不带检索的微调复现不出来的。做风格条件时，PersonaDrive 在每种风格上都超过最强基线 Drive My Way，驾驶分数高 6.7% 到 11.6%。驾驶行为也确实跟随指令，从保守到激进风格，平均速度上升 19.8%。每个交通智能体都作为独立驾驶策略单独评测。局限方面，材料未讨论。数据集和模型权重已在项目页公开。
1465a55bff71e654.why: 它把驾驶风格从间接标签换成真人按指令驾驶的演示，检索式风格切换不用重训练，对做交通流仿真和混合交通推演的人是可直接复用的数据与模型资源。

172d55e3d2976acf.text: Despite the rapid deployment of LLMs into classrooms, validating educational AI remains uniquely intractable: interventions act on developing learners whose cognitive and social trajectories are irreversibly shaped, while real-world trials are slow, ethically constrained, and institutionally locked. LLM-based educational simulators have emerged as a potential remedy, but many still collapse learning into persona-conditioned role-play and, when optimized only to reproduce existing classrooms, can structurally penalize the institutional novelty that pedagogical reform requires. In this work, we introduce AgentSchool, an LLM-driven multi-agent simulator that models learning as state transition rather than prompted behavior. AgentSchool couples cognitively growable student agents -- equipped with weighted subject knowledge graphs, thinking-workflow pools, and explicit misconceptions -- with adaptive teacher agents that plan, scaffold, and reflect along the Zone of Proximal Development, embedded in a configurable scenery generator that situates instruction within both formal and informal learning fields, and a multi-scale simulator that decouples interaction scale, temporal granularity, and simulation duration. Experiments show that structured student agents produce more differentiated mastery and misconception traces than a baseline simulator, while teacher-agent comparisons show backbone-dependent patterns consistent with ZPD-informed adaptation. Further, AgentSchool generates plausible traces of peripheral participation, clique formation, aggressor-induced cohesion, and opinion-leader emergence consistent with classroom social theories. Beyond its role as an educational research instrument, AgentSchool frames education as a socially meaningful testbed for long-horizon memory, multi-agent coordination, and future institutional reasoning under organizational pressure.
172d55e3d2976acf.abstract_zh: 教育 AI 的验证一直很难：干预作用于正在发展的学习者，真实课堂实验慢、受伦理限制、受制度约束。基于 LLM 的教育仿真器被当作可能的替代方案，但很多仿真器把学习简化成人设驱动的角色扮演，而且只优化到复现现有课堂时，会在结构上惩罚教学改革所需要的制度创新。AgentSchool 把学习建模成状态转移。学生智能体在认知上可成长，配备加权学科知识图谱、思维流程池和显式的错误概念；教师智能体沿最近发展区（ZPD）做规划、支架和反思。两者嵌入一个可配置的场景生成器，把教学置于正式与非正式学习场域中；多尺度仿真器则解耦了交互规模、时间粒度和仿真时长。实验方面，与基线仿真器相比，结构化学生智能体产生了更分化的掌握度和错误概念轨迹；教师智能体的对比呈现依赖骨干模型的模式，与 ZPD 指导的自适应一致。AgentSchool 还生成了与课堂社会理论一致的合理轨迹，包括边缘参与、小团体形成、攻击者引发的凝聚和意见领袖涌现。作者认为它除了作为教育研究工具，还把教育变成了检验长程记忆、多智能体协调和组织压力下制度推理的社会性测试场。
172d55e3d2976acf.why: 它把学习从角色扮演改成状态转移建模，并给出知识图谱、错误概念、ZPD 教师支架这套可复用的智能体设计，对做长程多智能体仿真的人有直接参考价值。

1e23cb2658b05eff.text: LLM-based web agents can navigate live storefronts, yet they often collapse to a single "average buyer" policy, failing to capture the heterogeneous and distributional nature of real buyer populations. Existing personalization methods rely on hand-crafted prompt-based personas that are brittle, difficult to scale, context-inefficient, and unable to faithfully represent population-level behavior. We introduce SimPersona, a novel framework that learns discrete buyer types from historical traffic and exposes them to LLM-based web agents as compact persona tokens. Given raw clickstreams, a behavior-aware VQ-VAE induces a discrete buyer-type space that captures the statistical structure of real buyer behavior and merchant-specific buyer population distributions. To provide behavior-specific guidance to LLM-based web agents, SimPersona maps each learned buyer type to a dedicated persona token in the LLM agent vocabulary and fine-tunes the agent with these tokens on real browsing traces. At inference, each synthetic buyer is assigned to a learned buyer type with a single encoder forward pass, requiring no retraining or store-specific prompt engineering. For population-level simulation, SimPersona samples buyer types from each merchant's empirical distribution over the learned VQ-VAE codebook and instantiates agents with the corresponding persona tokens, preserving merchant-specific buyer population distributions. Evaluated on $8.37$M buyers across $42$ held-out live storefronts, SimPersona achieves $78\%$ conversion-rate alignment with real buyers, exhibits interpretable behavioral variation across buyer types, and outperforms a baseline with $8\times$ more parameters on goal-oriented shopping tasks. We further release an open-source data pipeline that converts raw e-commerce event logs into buyer representations and agent-training traces.
1e23cb2658b05eff.abstract_zh: LLM 网页智能体能浏览真实电商网站，但往往收敛成单一的平均买家策略，无法刻画真实买家群体的异质性和分布特征。现有个性化方法依赖手工编写的提示词画像，脆弱、难扩展、上下文效率低，也难以忠实反映群体层面的行为。SimPersona 提出从历史流量中学习离散买家类型，再以紧凑的 persona token 提供给 LLM 智能体。具体做法是：用行为感知的 VQ-VAE 从原始点击流中诱导出一个离散买家类型空间，捕捉真实买家行为的统计结构和各商家的买家群体分布；每个学到的买家类型映射为 LLM 智能体词表中的一个专属 persona token，并在真实浏览轨迹上微调智能体。推理时，每个合成买家只需一次编码器前向传播即可归入某个买家类型，无需重训或针对店铺写提示词。做群体级仿真时，SimPersona 从各商家在 VQ-VAE 码本上的经验分布中采样买家类型，用对应 persona token 实例化智能体，从而保留商家特定的买家群体分布。在 42 个留出真实店铺、837 万买家的评测中，SimPersona 的转化率与真实买家对齐达 78%，各买家类型之间行为差异可解释，并在目标导向购物任务上超过参数量 8 倍的基线。作者还开源了一条数据管线，把原始电商事件日志转成买家表示和智能体训练轨迹。局限方面材料未展开讨论。
1e23cb2658b05eff.why: 它给出了一条可复用的路径，把真实行为数据压缩成离散画像 token 注入 LLM 智能体，做大规模、分布保真的买家群体仿真，还附带了事件日志转训练轨迹的开源管线。

brief.question: 解决 LLM 网页智能体在电商仿真中坍缩为单一“平均买家”策略、无法刻画真实买家群体异质分布的问题。
brief.setup: 基于 LLM 的网页智能体，在 42 个留出的真实在线商店上仿真买家群体，覆盖 837 万买家；智能体通过 persona token 接入学习到的离散买家类型。
brief.method: 用 behavior-aware VQ-VAE 从原始点击流中学习离散买家类型空间，每个类型映射为 LLM 词表中的一个 persona token，并在真实浏览轨迹上微调智能体；群体仿真时按各商家在 VQ-VAE codebook 上的经验分布采样买家类型，无需重新训练或针对商店写 prompt。
brief.findings: 在 837 万买家、42 个留出商店上，SimPersona 转化率与真实买家的一致性达 78%；不同买家类型呈现可解释的行为差异；在目标导向购物任务上超过参数量 8 倍的基线。
brief.validation: 与 42 个留出真实商店的真实买家转化率对比，一致性 78%；并与更大参数量基线在购物任务上对比。
brief.reuse: 开源了把原始电商事件日志转换为买家表示和智能体训练轨迹的数据 pipeline。

1a5f99ecc890da1b.text: Using offline datasets to evaluate conversational agents often fails to cover rare scenarios or to support testing new policies. This has motivated the use of controllable user simulators for targeted, counterfactual evaluation, typically implemented by prompting or fine-tuning large language models. In this work, we formalize controllable simulation as a causal inference problem. By bridging natural language evaluation with off-policy evaluation methodology, we show that the standard practice of training simulators via supervised fine-tuning on post-hoc trajectory labels yields a structurally biased model. Specifically, these labels are inextricably coupled to the data-generating behavior policy, injecting a look-ahead bias that breaks causal consistency. Furthermore, we prove that under policy shift this failure causes the variance of evaluation metrics to explode geometrically, a phenomenon we term controllability collapse. To restore causal consistency, we establish theoretical conditions for accurate simulation and propose practical training mitigations: a priori controls, step-wise dynamic controls, and direct policy-conditioned learning. Empirical evaluation confirms that while standard global controls distort conversational distributions and collapse behavioral diversity, our causally grounded simulators eliminate look-ahead bias, preserve natural variance, and exhibit robust zero-shot generalization to unseen agent behaviors.
1a5f99ecc890da1b.abstract_zh: 用离线数据集评测对话智能体，往往覆盖不到罕见场景，也没法测试新策略，因此研究者转向可控用户仿真器，通过提示或微调大模型来做针对性的反事实评测。这篇论文把可控仿真形式化为因果推断问题，把自然语言评测和离线策略评测（off-policy evaluation）的方法论接起来。作者证明，标准的做法是用事后标注的轨迹标签做监督微调，这些标签和生成数据的行为策略耦合在一起，注入了前瞻偏差，破坏了因果一致性。他们进一步证明，在策略偏移下这种失效会让评测指标的方差几何级数膨胀，作者把这个现象称为可控性崩塌。为恢复因果一致性，论文给出了准确仿真的理论条件，并提出三种实用的训练缓解方法：先验控制、逐步动态控制，以及直接的策略条件化学习。实验证实，标准的全局控制会扭曲对话分布、让行为多样性崩塌，而因果一致的仿真器消除了前瞻偏差，保留了自然方差，并且对未见过的智能体行为表现出稳健的零样本泛化。
1a5f99ecc890da1b.why: 它指出了当前用大模型微调做用户仿真的一条常见路径存在结构性偏差，并给出可操作的理论条件和三种训练方案，对做对话系统评测和反事实仿真的人都直接可用。

brief.question: 对话式智能体的评估问题：离线数据集覆盖不了罕见场景，也难以测试新策略，所以需要可控的用户模拟器做定向、反事实评估。作者要解决的是这类模拟器训练中的因果一致性问题。
brief.setup: 未说明。材料只讨论方法与理论，没有给出智能体数量、环境或时间尺度等仿真设定细节。
brief.method: 把可控模拟形式化为因果推断问题，连接自然语言评估与 off-policy evaluation 方法论。指出用事后轨迹标签做监督微调会让标签与数据生成的行为策略耦合，注入 look-ahead bias。提出三种训练缓解方案：a priori controls、step-wise dynamic controls、direct policy-conditioned learning。
brief.findings: 作者证明在策略偏移下，标准做法会让评估指标的方差呈几何级数爆炸，称之为 controllability collapse。实验显示标准全局控制会扭曲对话分布、使行为多样性坍缩，而因果化的模拟器消除了 look-ahead bias，保留自然方差，并对未见过的智能体行为有稳健的零样本泛化。
brief.validation: 材料称有 empirical evaluation 确认了上述结论，包括与标准全局控制方法的对比，但未说明具体数据集、基线或误差数字，验证强度无法从材料判断。
brief.limits: 材料未说明具体局限，但理论结论依赖策略偏移假设，且实验细节（数据、规模）未给出。
brief.reuse: 可直接借鉴的是三种训练缓解方案（a priori controls、step-wise dynamic controls、direct policy-conditioned learning）以及把可控模拟当作因果推断问题来形式化的思路。代码和数据未说明。

18a0dc9a34751113.text: Studies attempting to simulate human behavior with $\textit{Silicon Societies}$ grow in numbers while LLM-only social networks have started appearing outside of controlled settings. However, the design space of these networks remains under-studied, which contributes to a gap in validating model realism. To enable future works to make more informed design decisions, we perform a systematic analysis of the consequences and interactions of key design choices in simulated social networks, including the choice of base model used to model individual agents, and how they are connected to each other. Using surveys as a proxy for agent opinions, our findings suggest that the geometry of the design space is non-trivial, with some parameters behaving in additive ways while others display more complex interactions. In particular, the choice of the base LLM is the most important variable impacting the simulation outcomes.

174238aebb5e3f28.text: Semiconductor supply chains face unprecedented resilience challenges amidst global geopolitical turbulence. Conventional Large Language Model (LLM) planners, when confronting such non-stationary "Policy Black Swan" events, frequently suffer from Decision Paralysis or a severe Grounding Gap due to the absence of physical environmental modeling. This paper introduces ReflectiChain, a cognitive agentic framework tailored for resilient macroeconomic supply chain planning. The core innovation lies in the integration of Latent Trajectory Rehearsal powered by a generative world model, which couples reflection-in-action (System 2 deliberation) with delayed reflection-on-action. Furthermore, we leverage a Retrospective Agentic RL mechanism to enable autonomous policy evolution during the deployment phase (test-time). Evaluations conducted on our high-fidelity benchmark, Semi-Sim, demonstrate that under extreme scenarios such as export bans and material shortages, ReflectiChain achieves a 250% improvement in average step rewards over the strongest LLM baselines. It successfully restores the Operability Ratio (OR) from a deficient 13.3% to over 88.5% while ensuring robust gradient convergence. Ablation studies further underscore that the synergy between physical grounding constraints and double-loop learning is fundamental to bridging the gap between semantic reasoning and physical reality for long-horizon strategic planning.
174238aebb5e3f28.abstract_zh:
半导体供应链在全球地缘政治动荡下面临严峻的韧性挑战。作者指出，常规LLM规划器在应对这类非平稳的“政策黑天鹅”事件时，由于缺乏物理环境建模，经常出现决策瘫痪或严重的接地差距（Grounding Gap）。

论文提出ReflectiChain，一个面向韧性宏观经济供应链规划的认知智能体框架。核心创新是引入由生成式世界模型驱动的潜在轨迹排演（Latent Trajectory Rehearsal），把行动中反思（System 2式深思）与行动后延迟反思结合起来。此外还设计了回顾式智能体强化学习机制，让智能体在部署阶段（测试时）也能自主演化策略。

在高保真基准Semi-Sim上的评测显示，在出口禁令、原材料短缺等极端场景下，ReflectiChain的平均步进奖励比最强LLM基线提高250%，可运行率（OR）从13.3%的低水平恢复到88.5%以上，同时保证了梯度收敛的稳定性。消融实验进一步表明，物理接地约束与双环学习的协同作用，是弥合语义推理与物理现实之间差距、支撑长时程战略规划的基础。

局限方面，评测基于作者自建的Semi-Sim基准，材料中未提及与真实供应链数据的对比验证。
174238aebb5e3f28.why: 它给“LLM规划器缺乏物理环境建模导致接地差距”这个痛点提供了一个具体解法：生成式世界模型加双环学习加测试时策略演化，且附带了极端场景基准Semi-Sim，做危机推演和供应链仿真的研究者可以直接对照复用。

182e71ca4f407794.text: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become increasingly integrated into financial systems, understanding their behavioural properties is crucial. Do LLMs conform to the rational expectations paradigm, do they exhibit human-like "animal spirits", or do they instead manifest distinct "machine spirits"? We investigate these questions with a simulated financial market, exploring the behaviour of 15 LLMs spanning a range of sizes, capabilities, and providers. Our results show that LLMs exhibit a spectrum of economic behaviours, from stable coordination on the fundamental value to human-like speculative bubbles. These behaviours are generally inconsistent with the rational expectations hypothesis. We also consider an ecology of heterogeneous agents, a more realistic setting compared to markets with identical LLM agents. These mixed markets can produce outcomes which vary substantially across repeated simulations. Even the most advanced models fail to consistently stabilise the market, with price bubbles sometimes forming despite only a minority of agents naturally forming bubbles. Instead, advanced models in mixed markets adapt their forecasting strategies to the behaviour of other agents. This adaptation can allow them to successfully exploit less sophisticated counterparts and achieve higher profits, but can also contribute to increased market volatility. These findings suggest that the introduction of AI agents into financial markets fundamentally reshapes their ecology. In particular, heterogeneous populations of LLMs can generate endogenous instability, while individual-level adaptation may amplify, rather than mitigate, market volatility.
182e71ca4f407794.abstract_zh:
随着大模型越来越多地进入金融系统，理解它们的行为特征变得重要。作者提出一个问题：LLM 智能体是符合理性预期范式，还是表现出类似人类的“动物精神”，或者有自己独特的“机器精神”？他们搭建了一个模拟资产市场，让 15 个不同规模、能力和供应商的 LLM 参与交易。

结果显示，这些 LLM 表现出一个谱系式的经济行为：有的稳定协调在基本面价值附近，有的则产生类似人类的投机泡沫。这些行为总体上与理性预期假说不一致。作者进一步考察了异构智能体组成的混合市场，这比全部由同一个 LLM 组成的市场更接近现实。混合市场的重复模拟结果差异很大，即使最先进的模型也不能持续稳定市场，即便只有少数智能体天然会制造泡沫，价格泡沫仍可能形成。

更先进的模型在混合市场中会根据其他智能体的行为调整自己的预测策略。这种适应让它们能成功利用较弱的对手并获得更高利润，但也会推高市场波动。作者据此认为，AI 智能体进入金融市场会从根本上改变市场生态：异构 LLM 群体可以产生内生不稳定，而个体层面的适应可能放大而非缓解市场波动。
182e71ca4f407794.why: 它用受控实验直接检验了 LLM 交易者的行为偏差，并给出一个对市场仿真和金融监管都重要的反直觉结论：更聪明的模型不一定会稳定市场，反而可能通过适应性行为加剧波动。

brief.question: LLM 智能体在资产市场中是符合理性预期范式，还是表现出类似人类的“animal spirits”，或是独特的“machine spirits”行为。
brief.setup: 模拟金融市场，测试 15 个不同规模、能力和供应商的 LLM，并构建异构智能体混合市场（与同质 LLM 市场对比）。时间尺度未说明。
brief.method: 让 LLM 智能体在模拟金融市场中交易和预测，观察其价格行为；再在异构混合市场中重复多次仿真，考察智能体间的策略适应。
brief.findings: LLM 表现出从稳定收敛于基本价值到类人投机泡沫的连续行为谱，总体不符合理性预期假说。混合市场重复仿真结果差异很大，最先进的模型也无法稳定市场，少数天然形成泡沫的智能体也能引发价格泡沫。先进模型会适应其他智能体的行为，借此利用较弱对手获得更高利润，但也加剧了市场波动。
brief.validation: 未说明（材料未提及与真实市场数据或人类被试的定量对比）。
brief.limits: 作者指出异构 LLM 群体可产生内生不稳定性，个体层面的适应会放大而非缓解市场波动；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 未说明（材料未提供代码或数据）。

1f2084c00375fe51.text: The emergence of Large Language Models (LLMs) has illuminated the potential for a general-purpose user simulator. However, existing benchmarks remain constrained to isolated scenarios, narrow action spaces, or synthetic data, failing to capture the holistic nature of authentic human behavior. To bridge this gap, we introduce OmniBehavior, the first predictive user simulation benchmark constructed entirely from real-world data, integrating long-horizon, cross-scenario, and heterogeneous behavioral patterns into a unified framework. Based on this benchmark, we first provide empirical evidence that previous datasets with isolated scenarios suffer from tunnel vision, whereas real-world decision-making relies on long-term, cross-scenario causal chains. Extensive evaluations of state-of-the-art LLMs reveal that current models struggle to accurately predict these complex behaviors, with performance plateauing even as context windows expand. Crucially, a systematic comparison between simulated and authentic behaviors uncovers a fundamental structural bias: LLMs tend to converge towards a positive average person, exhibiting hyper-activity, persona homogenization, and a utopian bias. This results in the loss of individual differences and long-tail behaviors, highlighting critical directions for future high-fidelity simulation research.
1f2084c00375fe51.abstract_zh: 现有 LLM 用户模拟基准大多局限在孤立场景、狭窄的动作空间或合成数据上，难以反映真实人类行为的整体面貌。作者提出 OmniBehavior，这是第一个完全用真实世界数据构建的预测式用户模拟基准，把长时程、跨场景、异质的行为模式统一到一个框架里。基于这个基准，作者先给出实证：孤立场景的数据集会让模型产生“隧道视野”，而真实世界的决策依赖长期的、跨场景的因果链。随后对多个最先进 LLM 的系统评测表明，当前模型很难准确预测这些复杂行为，即便扩大上下文窗口，性能也停滞不前。更关键的发现来自模拟行为与真实行为的系统对比：LLM 存在一种根本性的结构偏差，倾向于收敛成一个“积极的平均人”，表现为过度活跃、人设同质化和乌托邦式偏差。这导致个体差异和长尾行为在模拟中丢失，指出了未来高保真模拟研究需要解决的方向。材料未说明基准的具体数据来源和规模细节。
1f2084c00375fe51.why: 它用真实数据揭示了一个反直觉结论：堆上下文窗口救不了行为模拟，且 LLM 会抹平个体差异和长尾行为，这对任何想用 LLM 做用户或人群仿真的研究者都是必须知道的风险。

brief.question: 现有 LLM 用户仿真基准局限于孤立场景、窄动作空间和合成数据，无法刻画真实人类行为的全貌。OmniBehavior 想推演的是 LLM 能否在长时程、跨场景、异质行为的真实数据上准确预测用户行为。
brief.setup: 材料未说明具体的智能体数量、环境细节和时间尺度。基准 OmniBehavior 完全由真实世界数据构建，整合长时程、跨场景、异质行为模式到统一框架中，评测对象是当前最先进的 LLM。
brief.method: 用真实行为数据构建预测式用户仿真基准，系统比较模型仿真行为与真实行为，并对比孤立场景数据与跨场景长时程数据的表现差异。
brief.findings: 孤立场景数据集存在 tunnel vision（管窥）问题，真实决策依赖长时程跨场景因果链。最先进 LLM 在该基准上表现不佳，扩大上下文窗口后性能仍趋于平台期。仿真行为与真实行为对比发现 LLM 收敛为“正向平均人”，表现出 hyper-activity（过度活跃）、persona homogenization（人格同质化）和 utopian bias（乌托邦偏差），丢失个体差异和长尾行为。
brief.validation: 材料提到做了仿真行为与真实行为的系统性对比，以及扩大上下文窗口的实验，但未给出具体误差数字或与人类基线的定量对比。
brief.limits: 当前 LLM 无法准确预测复杂真实行为，存在结构性偏差，个体差异和长尾行为丢失。材料未说明基准本身的覆盖范围和数据规模等局限。
brief.reuse: OmniBehavior 基准可作为高保真用户仿真研究的评测工具，其仿真与真实行为的对比方法可用于诊断 LLM 仿真偏差。代码和数据是否公开未说明。

1244abc79f2a8731.text: Mitigating elderly loneliness requires policy interventions that achieve both adaptability and auditability. Existing methods struggle to reconcile these objectives: traditional agent-based models suffer from static rigidity, while direct large language model (LLM) controllers lack essential traceability. This work proposes a three-layer framework that separates diagnosis from control to achieve both properties simultaneously. LLMs operate strictly as diagnostic instruments that assess population state and generate structured risk evaluations, while deterministic formulas with explicit bounds translate these assessments into traceable parameter updates. This separation ensures that every policy decision can be attributed to inspectable rules while maintaining adaptive response to emergent needs. We validate the framework through systematic ablation across five experimental conditions in elderly care simulation. Results demonstrate that explicit control rules outperform end-to-end black-box LLM approaches by 11.7\% while preserving full auditability, confirming that transparency need not compromise adaptive performance.
1244abc79f2a8731.abstract_zh: 缓解老年人孤独感需要政策干预同时具备适应性和可审计性。现有方法难以兼顾两者：传统基于智能体的模型参数静态、缺乏弹性；直接用大语言模型做控制器则缺少可追溯性。作者提出一个三层框架，把诊断和控制分开。LLM 严格作为诊断工具，评估人群状态并生成结构化的风险评价；带明确边界的确定性公式再把这些评价转成可追溯的参数更新。这种分离保证每个政策决策都能归因到可检查的规则，同时保持对涌现需求的适应性响应。作者在养老仿真中通过五种实验条件的系统消融验证该框架。结果显示，显式控制规则比端到端 LLM 黑盒方法高出 11.7%，且保留完整可审计性，说明透明性不必以牺牲自适应性能为代价。局限方面，材料未展开讨论。
1244abc79f2a8731.why: 它给出一个可复用的架构思路：让 LLM 只做诊断、确定性公式做控制，在需要可审计的政策仿真里兼顾适应性和可追溯性，并有消融数据支撑。

1e96458cce8597a5.text: In perpetrator treatment, a recurring observation is the dissociation between insight and action: offenders articulate remorse yet behavioral change does not follow. We report four preregistered studies (1,584 multi-agent simulations across 16 languages and three model families) demonstrating that alignment interventions in large language models produce a structurally analogous phenomenon: surface safety that masks or generates collective pathology and internal dissociation. In Study 1 (N = 150), increasing alignment-instructed agents reduced collective pathology in English (g = -1.844, p < .0001) but amplified it in Japanese (g = +0.771, p = .038)--a directional reversal we term "alignment backfire." Study 2 (N = 1,174) extended to 16 languages: alignment-induced dissociation was near-universal (15/16 languages; beta = 0.0667, p < .0001), while collective pathology bifurcated along cultural-linguistic lines (interaction beta = 0.0684, p = .0003), correlating with Power Distance Index (r = 0.474, p = .064). Study 3 (N = 180) tested individuation as countermeasure; individuated agents became the primary source of both pathology and dissociation (DI = +1.120) with conformity above 84%--demonstrating iatrogenesis. Study 4 (N = 80) validated patterns across Llama 3.3 70B, GPT-4o-mini, and Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B, confirming English safety is model-general while Japanese backfire is model-specific. These findings reframe alignment as a behavioral intervention subject to risk homeostasis and iatrogenesis. Language space--the linguistic, pragmatic, and cultural properties inherited from training data--structurally determines alignment outcomes. Safety validated in English does not transfer to other languages, and prompt-level interventions cannot override language-space-level constraints.
1e96458cce8597a5.abstract_zh: 作者借用犯罪矫治领域的一个观察：加害者能口头表达悔意但行为不变，即洞察与行动解离。四项预注册研究（共 1584 次多智能体仿真，覆盖 16 种语言、三个模型家族）显示，大模型的对齐干预会产生结构上类似的现象，表面安全掩盖或反而生成集体病理与内在解离。研究一（N=150）中，增加带对齐指令的智能体在英语里降低了集体病理（g=-1.844，p<.0001），在日语里却放大了它（g=+0.771，p=.038），作者把这个方向反转称为 alignment backfire。研究二（N=1174）扩展到 16 种语言：对齐诱导的解离几乎普遍存在（15/16 种语言，beta=0.0667，p<.0001），集体病理则沿文化语言界线分化（交互项 beta=0.0684，p=.0003），并与权力距离指数相关（r=0.474，p=.064）。研究三（N=180）测试了个性化（individuation）作为对策，结果个性化的智能体反而成为病理和解离的主要来源（DI=+1.120），从众率超过 84%，作者认为这是医源性伤害。研究四（N=80）在 Llama 3.3 70B、GPT-4o-mini 和 Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B 上验证了这些模式：英语的安全效果跨模型成立，日语的反转是模型特定的。作者据此把对齐重新定义为一种受风险稳态和医源性效应约束的行为干预，认为语言空间（训练数据继承的语言、语用与文化属性）在结构上决定对齐结果，英语里验证的安全不能迁移到其他语言，提示层面的干预无法覆盖语言空间层面的约束。
1e96458cce8597a5.why: 它用预注册、跨 16 种语言的大规模多智能体实验给出一个反例：对齐提示在非英语环境可能放大集体病理，做跨语言仿真或部署多智能体安全干预的人需要先验证语言迁移性。

brief.question: 检验 LLM 多智能体系统中的对齐干预是否会在不同语言中产生反向效果，即所谓 alignment backfire 现象。
brief.setup: 四项预注册研究，共 1,584 次多智能体仿真，覆盖 16 种语言和三个模型家族（Llama 3.3 70B、GPT-4o-mini、Qwen3-Next-80B-A3B）。
brief.method: 在多智能体系统中加入接受对齐指令的智能体，测量集体病理（collective pathology）与内部分离（dissociation）指标；Study 3 测试个体化（individuation）作为对策；Study 4 跨三个模型验证模式。
brief.findings: Study 1（N=150）中增加对齐智能体在英语里降低集体病理（g = -1.844, p < .0001），但在日语里放大病理（g = +0.771, p = .038），作者称之为 alignment backfire。Study 2（N=1,174）扩展到 16 种语言，对齐诱发的分离在 15/16 种语言中出现（beta = 0.0667, p < .0001），集体病理沿文化-语言线分化（interaction beta = 0.0684, p = .0003），与 Power Distance Index 相关（r = 0.474, p = .064）。Study 3（N=180）中个体化智能体反而成为病理和分离的主要来源（DI = +1.120），从众率超过 84%，构成医源性伤害。Study
brief.validation: 四项研究均为预注册；跨 16 种语言、三个模型家族重复实验，报告了效应量、p 值和交互项。未与真实世界人类群体数据对比。
brief.limits: 日语 backfire 是模型特异的，不能一概而论；Power Distance Index 相关性 p = .064 未达常规显著水平；prompt 层面干预无法覆盖语言空间层面的约束。

1259c1a3d97b125d.text: The utility of Role-Playing Language Agents in sociological research is growing alongside the adoption of Large Language Models. For realism in social simulation, these agents must adhere to their personas defined by character profiles, yet existing strategies-static prompt engineering or costly fine-tuning-fail to adapt personas to dynamic scenarios. Psychological theories, such as the Cognitive-Affective Personality Systems, provide a crucial explanation for this failure: a persona's influence on behavior is not static but varies with the scenarios. This context-dependence highlights the critical need for adaptive persona management. To address this gap, we propose a novel, theory-driven method that dynamically estimates context-dependent persona importance and integrates it into weighted reward-guided decoding, enabling inference-time persona following. Specifically, we introduce the Persona Dynamic Decoding (PDD) framework, which consists of two key components: (1) Persona Importance Estimation (PIE) module, which dynamically quantifies the contextual importance of persona attributes without requiring ground-truth supervision; and (2) Persona-Guided Inference-Time Alignment (PIA) paradigm, which leverages these importance scores to construct weighted multi-objective rewards and modulate generation probabilities during inference. Extensive experiments show the effectiveness of our method in utterance consistency and behavioral fidelity.

12f64111a08d91c8.text: Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have spurred growing interest in using LLM-integrated agents for social simulation, often under the implicit assumption that realistic population dynamics will emerge once role-specified agents are placed in a networked multi-agent setting. This position paper argues that LLM-based agents alone are not (yet) sufficient for social simulation. We attribute this over-optimism to a systematic mismatch between what current agent pipelines are typically optimized and validated to produce and what simulation-as-science requires. Concretely, role-playing plausibility does not imply faithful human behavioral validity; collective outcomes are frequently mediated by agent-environment co-dynamics rather than agent-agent messaging alone; and results can be dominated by interaction protocols, scheduling, and initial information priors. To make these underlying mechanisms explicit and auditable, we propose a unified formulation of AI agent-based social simulation as an environment-involved Markov game with explicit exposure and scheduling mechanisms, from which we derive concrete actions for design, evaluation, and interpretation.
12f64111a08d91c8.abstract_zh: 背景与问题：随着大语言模型（LLM）的进展，越来越多研究者把角色化 LLM 智能体放进网络化多智能体环境做社会仿真，并默认真实的人口动态会自然涌现。作者认为这种乐观是系统性的错配，即当前智能体流水线通常优化和验证的目标，与“仿真作为科学”的要求并不一致。做法：论文具体指出三点机制。第一，角色扮演的合理性并不代表忠实于真实人类行为。第二，集体结果常常由智能体与环境的共同动态（agent-environment co-dynamics）中介，而不只是智能体之间的消息传递。第三，结果可能被交互协议、调度方式和初始信息先验主导。为了让这些机制显式化、可审计，作者提出把基于 AI 智能体的社会仿真统一表述为一个环境参与型马尔可夫博弈（environment-involved Markov game），其中包含显式的暴露机制与调度机制。结果与意义：从这一统一表述出发，作者推导出在设计、评估和解释社会仿真时的具体行动建议。这是一篇立场论文，材料未说明是否包含实验验证。
12f64111a08d91c8.why: 它直接质疑了当前 LLM 社会仿真“搭好智能体就能涌现真实动态”的流行假设，并给出了可操作的统一形式化框架，对做仿真推演的研究者是重要的方法论警示与设计指南。

brief.question: 推演的问题是用 LLM 智能体做社会仿真是否已经可行，论文立场是当前 AI 智能体单独还不足以支撑社会仿真。
brief.setup: 这是一篇立场论文（position paper），没有实际搭建仿真实验，材料未说明智能体数量、环境、时间尺度和使用的具体模型。
brief.method: 提出把基于 AI 智能体的社会仿真统一表述为一个环境参与的马尔可夫博弈（environment-involved Markov game），并显式建模信息暴露（exposure）与调度（scheduling）机制，据此推导设计、评估和解释上的具体行动。
brief.findings: 核心论点有三条：角色扮演的合理性不等于忠实的人类行为效度；集体结果往往由智能体与环境的共同动态（agent-environment co-dynamics）驱动，而不只靠智能体之间的消息传递；结果可能被交互协议、调度方式和初始信息先验主导。
brief.validation: 未说明，论文为立场性论证，材料中没有与真实数据或人类行为的对比实验。
brief.limits: 材料未说明具体实验局限，但论文本身指出的风险是当前智能体管线的优化和验证目标与社会仿真作为科学方法的要求存在系统性错配，容易导致过度乐观。
brief.reuse: 可借鉴的是把社会仿真形式化为带显式 exposure 和 scheduling 机制的马尔可夫博弈这一框架，以及据此推导的设计、评估和解释清单。代码和数据材料未说明。

1c0ea01c216bb948.text: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly trained in complex Reinforcement Learning, multi-agent environments, making it difficult to understand how behavior changes over training. Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have recently shown to be useful for data-centric interpretability. In this work, we analyze large-scale reinforcement learning training runs from the sophisticated environment of Full-Press Diplomacy by applying pretrained SAEs, alongside LLM-summarizer methods. We introduce Meta-Autointerp, a method for grouping SAE features into interpretable hypotheses about training dynamics. We discover fine-grained behaviors including role-playing patterns, degenerate outputs, language switching, alongside high-level strategic behaviors and environment-specific bugs. Through automated evaluation, we validate that 90% of discovered SAE Meta-Features are significant, and find a surprising reward hacking behavior. However, through two user studies, we find that even subjectively interesting and seemingly helpful SAE features may be worse than useless to humans, along with most LLM generated hypotheses. However, a subset of SAE-derived hypotheses are predictively useful for downstream tasks. We further provide validation by augmenting an untrained agent's system prompt, improving the score by +14.2%. Overall, we show that SAEs and LLM-summarizer provide complementary views into agent behavior, and together our framework forms a practical starting point for future data-centric interpretability work on ensuring trustworthy LLM behavior throughout training.

1c16631ca88cafed.text: SmartFlow is a multi-layered framework that integrates Reinforcement Learning and Agentic AI to address the dynamic rebalancing problem in urban bike-sharing services. Its architecture separates strategic, tactical, and communication functions for clarity and scalability. At the strategic level, a Deep Q-Network (DQN) agent, trained in a high-fidelity simulation of New Yorks Citi Bike network, learns robust rebalancing policies by modelling the challenge as a Markov Decision Process. These high-level strategies feed into a deterministic tactical module that optimises multi-leg journeys and schedules just-in-time dispatches to minimise fleet travel. Evaluation across multiple seeded runs demonstrates SmartFlows high efficacy, reducing network imbalance by over 95% while requiring minimal travel distance and achieving strong truck utilisation. A communication layer, powered by a grounded Agentic AI with a Large Language Model (LLM), translates logistical plans into clear, actionable instructions for operational staff, ensuring interpretability and execution readiness. This integration bridges machine intelligence with human operations, offering a scalable solution that reduces idle time, improves bike availability, and lowers operational costs. SmartFlow provides a blueprint for interpretable, AI-driven logistics in complex urban mobility networks.

1d9f2564b1ab783f.text: Workplace toxicity is widely recognized as detrimental to organizational culture, yet quantifying its direct impact on operational efficiency remains methodologically challenging due to the ethical and practical difficulties of reproducing conflict in human subjects. This study leverages Large Language Model (LLM) based Multi-Agent Systems to simulate 1-on-1 adversarial debates, creating a controlled "sociological sandbox". We employ a Monte Carlo method to simulate hundrets of discussions, measuring the convergence time (defined as the number of arguments required to reach a conclusion) between a baseline control group and treatment groups involving agents with "toxic" system prompts. Our results demonstrate a statistically significant increase of approximately 25\% in the duration of conversations involving toxic participants. We propose that this "latency of toxicity" serves as a proxy for financial damage in corporate and academic settings. Furthermore, we demonstrate that agent-based modeling provides a reproducible, ethical alternative to human-subject research for measuring the mechanics of social friction.
1d9f2564b1ab783f.abstract_zh: 职场毒性行为对组织文化的危害已有共识，但要在真人身上复现冲突来量化它对运营效率的直接影响，存在伦理和实操上的困难。这项研究改用基于大模型的多智能体系统模拟一对一对抗性辩论，构造一个可控的“社会学沙盒”。作者采用蒙特卡洛方法模拟数百场讨论，度量收敛时间，即达成结论所需的论证数量，比较基线对照组与包含“毒性”系统提示智能体的实验组。结果显示，涉及有毒参与者的对话时长增加约 25%，具有统计显著性。作者提出这种“毒性延迟”可以作为企业和学术环境中经济损失的代理指标。研究还表明，基于智能体的建模为测量社会摩擦的机制提供了一种可复现、合乎伦理的替代真人实验的方法。局限在于材料未说明模拟结论与真实组织数据的对照，毒性效应目前只在对话耗时这一个维度上量化。
1d9f2564b1ab783f.why: 它示范了用 LLM 多智能体加蒙特卡洛把一个难以做真人实验的社会问题变成可量化、可复现的仿真实验，对想用仿真测社会摩擦成本的研究者是可直接借鉴的方法模板。

brief.question: 职场不文明行为（toxicity）对运营效率的直接影响难以量化，因为无法在真人身上合乎伦理地复现冲突。作者用 LLM 多智能体仿真来推演 1 对 1 对抗性辩论，量化有毒参与者带来的效率损失。
brief.setup: LLM 驱动的多智能体系统，模拟 1 对 1 对抗性辩论，构成一个可控的“社会学沙盘”。对照组为基线智能体，处理组使用带 toxic 系统提示词的智能体。具体模型名称和智能体总数未说明，仅提到用 Monte Carlo 方法模拟数百场讨论。
brief.method: Monte Carlo 方法重复模拟数百场讨论，度量收敛时间（定义为达成结论所需的论证轮数），比较对照组与 toxic 处理组的差异。
brief.findings: 含 toxic 参与者的对话时长增加约 25%，统计显著。作者将这种“toxicity 的延迟”（latency of toxicity）作为企业和学术场景中经济损失的代理指标。
brief.validation: 未说明。文中未提及与真实人类数据对比、消融实验或具体统计检验方式，仅称结果统计显著。
brief.limits: 未说明。材料未讨论 LLM 智能体能否真实代表人类冲突行为，也未说明 toxic 提示词的具体构造。
brief.reuse: 方法上可借鉴：用 toxic 系统提示词构造处理组、以收敛轮数为度量、Monte Carlo 重复采样比较组间差异。代码和数据未说明是否公开。

1ac2d5bc00227f6a.text: Using Large Language Models (LLMs) to simulate user opinions has received growing attention. Yet LLMs, especially trained with reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), are known to exhibit biases toward dominant viewpoints, raising concerns about their ability to represent users from diverse demographic and cultural backgrounds. In this work, we examine the extent to which LLMs can simulate human responses to cross-domain survey questions through direct prompting and chain-of-thought prompting. We further propose a claim diversification method CLAIMSIM, which elicits viewpoints from LLM parametric knowledge as contextual input. Experiments on the survey question answering task indicate that, while CLAIMSIM produces more diverse responses, both approaches struggle to accurately simulate users. Further analysis reveals two key limitations: (1) LLMs tend to maintain fixed viewpoints across varying demographic features, and generate single-perspective claims; and (2) when presented with conflicting claims, LLMs struggle to reason over nuanced differences among demographic features, limiting their ability to adapt responses to specific user profiles.
1ac2d5bc00227f6a.abstract_zh: 用大模型模拟用户观点近年受到关注，但经过 RLHF 训练的大模型已知偏向主流观点，能否代表不同人口和文化背景的用户存在疑问。作者考察了大模型通过直接提示和思维链提示模拟人类回答跨领域问卷问题的程度，并提出 CLAIMSIM 方法，从大模型的参数知识中引出多种观点，作为上下文输入来促进回答多样化。在问卷问答任务上的实验表明，CLAIMSIM 确实能产生更多样的回答，但两种方法都不能准确模拟用户。进一步分析揭示两个局限：其一，大模型在不同人口特征下倾向保持固定观点，只生成单一视角的论断；其二，面对相互冲突的论断时，大模型难以就人口特征间的细微差异进行推理，无法针对特定用户画像调整回答。
1ac2d5bc00227f6a.why: 它给出一个反例：即使专门设计多样化方法，大模型模拟问卷受访者仍然失真，做合成样本或社会仿真的人需要正视这个局限。

brief.question: LLM 能否准确模拟不同人口和文化背景用户在跨领域调查问卷上的回答，尤其是 RLHF 训练的模型偏向主流观点时如何改进模拟的多样性。
brief.setup: 在调查问卷问答任务上测试 LLM 模拟用户回答，比较直接提示和思维链提示两种方式，未说明具体模型名称、智能体数量和时间尺度。
brief.method: 提出 CLAIMSIM 方法，先从 LLM 参数化知识中引出多种观点声明，作为上下文输入，以增加回答多样性（claim diversification）。
brief.findings: CLAIMSIM 生成的回答更多样，但两种方法都难以准确模拟真实用户。分析发现两个局限：LLM 在不同人口特征下保持固定观点，倾向生成单一视角的声明；面对相互冲突的声明时，LLM 难以在细微的人口特征差异上做推理，无法针对特定用户画像调整回答。
brief.validation: 在调查问卷问答任务上做实验并进一步分析，未说明与真实调查数据对比的具体误差数字或消融强度。
brief.limits: LLM 对主流观点的偏向（RLHF 相关）；跨人口特征观点固定、单视角生成；对冲突声明的细粒度推理能力不足。
brief.reuse: CLAIMSIM 的观点多样化方法：从 LLM 参数化知识引出多视角声明作为上下文输入，可直接借鉴；未说明代码和数据是否公开。

1146fe24388c1baa.text: The emergence of large language models (LLMs) has sparked much interest in creating LLM-based digital populations that can be applied to many applications such as social simulation, crowdsourcing, marketing, and recommendation systems. A digital population can reduce the cost of recruiting human participants and alleviate many concerns related to human subject study. However, research has found that most of the existing works rely solely on LLMs and could not sufficiently capture the accuracy and diversity of a real human population. To address this limitation, we propose CrowdLLM that integrates pretrained LLMs and generative models to enhance the diversity and fidelity of the digital population. We conduct theoretical analysis of CrowdLLM regarding its great potential in creating cost-effective, sufficiently representative, scalable digital populations that can match the quality of a real crowd. Comprehensive experiments are also conducted across multiple domains (e.g., crowdsourcing, voting, user rating) and simulation studies which demonstrate that CrowdLLM achieves promising performance in both accuracy and distributional fidelity to human data.
1146fe24388c1baa.abstract_zh: 大语言模型的出现让研究者开始尝试构建基于 LLM 的数字人口，用于社会仿真、众包、营销和推荐系统等场景。数字人口可以省去招募真人被试的成本，也回避了人体被试研究中的诸多顾虑。但已有研究发现，现有工作大多只靠 LLM 本身，难以充分捕捉真实人类群体的准确性和多样性。针对这个局限，作者提出 CrowdLLM，把预训练 LLM 与生成模型结合，提升数字人口的多样性和保真度。作者还对 CrowdLLM 做了理论分析，论证它在构建低成本、足够有代表性、可扩展且质量能对齐真实人群的数字人口方面的潜力。实验覆盖众包、投票、用户评分等多个领域，并做了仿真研究，结果显示 CrowdLLM 在准确率和与人类数据的分布保真度两方面都表现良好。材料未给出具体数字结果，局限也未展开讨论。
1146fe24388c1baa.why: 它针对纯 LLM 合成人口多样性不足这一已知痛点给出了生成模型增强的方案，并在多个领域与真实人类数据做了分布层面的对照，对想用合成样本替代真人被试的研究者有直接参考价值。

brief.question: 现有 LLM 数字人口研究大多只依赖 LLM 本身，难以充分捕捉真实人群的准确性和多样性，CrowdLLM 要解决这个问题，构建可用于社会仿真、众包、营销和推荐系统等场景的数字人群。
brief.setup: 材料未给出具体的智能体数量、环境设定和时间尺度。方法基于预训练 LLM 与生成式模型的组合。
brief.method: CrowdLLM 将预训练 LLM 与生成式模型集成，用生成式模型增强数字人群的多样性和保真度，并对其构建成本效益、代表性和可扩展性做了理论分析。
brief.findings: 在多个领域（众包、投票、用户评分）和仿真研究上实验，CrowdLLM 在准确性和对人类数据的分布保真度上都取得了 promising performance，材料未给出具体数字。
brief.validation: 与人类数据对比了准确性和分布保真度（accuracy and distributional fidelity to human data），但材料未说明对比的具体数据集、指标数值或验证强度。
brief.limits: 材料提到现有仅依赖 LLM 的方法无法充分捕捉真实人群的准确性和多样性，这是 CrowdLLM 的出发点；CrowdLLM 自身的局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 材料未说明是否公开代码或数据，可借鉴的是 LLM 与生成式模型集成来增强数字人群多样性的思路。

1646a84bab386c53.text: This paper introduces a novel framework for simulating and analyzing how uncooperative behaviors can destabilize or collapse LLM-based multi-agent systems. Our framework includes two key components: (1) a game theory-based taxonomy of uncooperative agent behaviors, addressing a notable gap in the existing literature; and (2) a structured, multi-stage simulation pipeline that dynamically generates and refines uncooperative behaviors as agents' states evolve. We evaluate the framework via a collaborative resource management setting, measuring system stability using metrics such as survival time and resource overuse rate. Empirically, our framework achieves 96.7% accuracy in generating realistic uncooperative behaviors, validated by human evaluations. Our results reveal a striking contrast: cooperative agents maintain perfect system stability (100% survival over 12 rounds with 0% resource overuse), while any uncooperative behavior can trigger rapid system collapse within 1 to 7 rounds. We also evaluate LLM-based defense methods, finding they detect some uncooperative behaviors, but some behaviors remain largely undetectable. These gaps highlight how uncooperative agents degrade collective outcomes and underscore the need for more resilient multi-agent systems.
1646a84bab386c53.abstract_zh:
这篇论文研究不合作行为如何破坏 LLM 多智能体系统的稳定性。作者指出，现有文献缺少对不合作智能体行为的系统分类，于是提出一个框架，包含两部分：一是基于博弈论的不合作行为分类法；二是一个结构化的多阶段仿真流程，随着智能体状态演化，动态生成并迭代不合作行为。

实验在一个协作资源管理场景中进行，用存活时间和资源滥用率衡量系统稳定性。人工评估显示，框架生成的不合作行为有 96.7% 被判定为真实可信。结果对比明显：全部合作的智能体系统在 12 轮中保持 100% 存活、0% 资源滥用；而只要出现任何不合作行为，系统会在 1 到 7 轮内崩溃。

作者还测试了基于 LLM 的防御方法，发现它们能检测出部分不合作行为，但另一些行为几乎检测不到。这些盲区说明不合作智能体会显著拉低集体结果，也说明多智能体系统需要更强的韧性机制。
1646a84bab386c53.why: 它给了不合作行为一个可操作的博弈论分类和可复用的仿真流程，并用具体数字展示了单个背叛者对系统稳定性的破坏速度，对做多智能体仿真和鲁棒性测试的人都直接有用。

brief.question: 研究 LLM 多智能体系统中的不合作行为（背叛/不配合）如何破坏系统稳定，以及现有防御方法能否检测这类行为。
brief.setup: 在协作资源管理场景中做仿真，智能体状态随轮次演化，共观察 12 轮；具体智能体数量与所用 LLM 模型未说明。
brief.method: 提出一个框架，包含两部分：基于博弈论的不合作行为分类体系，以及一个多阶段仿真管线，随智能体状态动态生成并迭代细化不合作行为。
brief.findings: 框架生成的不合作行为经人类评估达到 96.7% 的真实度。合作型智能体 12 轮全部存活、资源过度使用率为 0%；而任何不合作行为都能在 1 到 7 轮内引发系统崩溃。LLM 防御方法能检测出部分不合作行为，但另一些行为基本检测不到。
brief.validation: 由人类评估生成行为是否真实，准确率 96.7%；系统稳定性用存活时间和资源过度使用率衡量。未与真实世界数据对比。
brief.limits: 防御方法对部分不合作行为基本失效，说明现有 LLM 防御存在盲区；其他局限未说明。
brief.reuse: 可复用博弈论不合作行为分类体系和多阶段动态生成仿真管线；代码与数据是否开源未说明。

1728a397ee3eeb8c.text: In this study, we evaluate the persona fidelity of frontier LLMs, GPT-5, Claude Sonnet 4.5 and Gemini 2.5 Flash when assigned distinct socioeconomic personas performing scholastic assessment test (SAT) mathematics items and affective preference tasks. Across 15 distinct role conditions and three testing scenarios, GPT-5 exhibited complete contextual collapse and adopted a singular identity towards optimal responses (PERMANOVA p=1.000, R^2=0.0004), while Gemini 2.5 Flash showed partial collapse (p=0.120, R^2=0.0020). Claude Sonnet 4.5 retained limited but measurable role-specific variation on the SAT items (PERMANOVA p<0.001, R^2=0.0043), though with inverted SES-performance relationships where low-SES personas outperformed high-SES personas (eta^2 = 0.15-0.19 in extended replication). However, all models exhibited distinct role-conditioned affective preference (average d = 0.52-0.58 vs near zero separation for math), indicating that socio-affective variation can reemerge when cognitive constraints are relaxed. These findings suggest that distributional fidelity failure originates in task-dependent contextual collapse: optimization-driven identity convergence under cognitive load combined with impaired role-contextual understanding. Realistic social simulations may require embedding contextual priors in the model's post-training alignment and not just distributional calibration to replicate human-like responses. Beyond simulation validity, these results have implications for survey data integrity, as LLMs can express plausible demographic variation on preference items while failing to maintain authentic reasoning constraints.

1f0a89853feac1e1.text: Leveraging large language models (LLMs) in traffic signal control (TSC) improves optimization efficiency and interpretability compared to traditional reinforcement learning (RL) methods. However, existing LLM-based approaches are limited by fixed time signal durations and are prone to hallucination errors, while RL methods lack robustness in signal timing decisions and suffer from poor generalization. To address these challenges, this paper proposes HeraldLight, a dual LLMs architecture enhanced by Herald guided prompts. The Herald Module extracts contextual information and forecasts queue lengths for each traffic phase based on real-time conditions. The first LLM, LLM-Agent, uses these forecasts to make fine grained traffic signal control, while the second LLM, LLM-Critic, refines LLM-Agent's outputs, correcting errors and hallucinations. These refined outputs are used for score-based fine-tuning to improve accuracy and robustness. Simulation experiments using CityFlow on real world datasets covering 224 intersections in Jinan (12), Hangzhou (16), and New York (196) demonstrate that HeraldLight outperforms state of the art baselines, achieving a 20.03% reduction in average travel time across all scenarios and a 10.74% reduction in average queue length on the Jinan and Hangzhou scenarios. The source code is available on GitHub: https://github.com/BUPT-ANTlab/HeraldLight.

178b4f9c6d9aa673.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new avenues to simulate online communities and social media. Potential applications range from testing the design of content recommendation algorithms to estimating the effects of content policies and interventions. However, the validity of using LLMs to simulate conversations between various users remains largely untested. We evaluated whether LLMs can convincingly mimic human group conversations on social media. We collected authentic human conversations from Reddit and generated artificial conversations on the same topic with two LLMs: Llama 3 70B and GPT-4o. When presented side-by-side to study participants, LLM-generated conversations were mistaken for human-created content 39\% of the time. In particular, when evaluating conversations generated by Llama 3, participants correctly identified them as AI-generated only 56\% of the time, barely better than random chance. Our study demonstrates that LLMs can generate social media conversations sufficiently realistic to deceive humans when reading them, highlighting both a promising potential for social simulation and a warning message about the potential misuse of LLMs to generate new inauthentic social media content.
178b4f9c6d9aa673.abstract_zh: 大语言模型为模拟在线社区和社交媒体提供了新途径，可用于测试内容推荐算法的设计，或估计内容政策和干预措施的效果。但 LLM 能否逼真地模拟多用户之间的对话，此前几乎没有经过检验。作者把这个问题设计成一次集体图灵测试。他们先从 Reddit 收集真实的人类群组对话，再让 Llama 3 70B 和 GPT-4o 在相同话题上生成人工对话，然后把两类对话并排呈现给研究参与者辨认。结果显示，LLM 生成的对话有 39% 被误认为是人类创作的。其中 Llama 3 生成的对话，参与者只有 56% 的比例能正确识别出是 AI 生成，仅比随机猜测略好。这说明 LLM 已经能生成足够逼真的社交媒体对话，在读的人层面骗过人类。作者认为这既展示了 LLM 用于社会仿真的潜力，也构成一个警示，即 LLM 可能被滥用来制造虚假的社交媒体内容。材料未说明参与者人数、话题范围等实验细节。
178b4f9c6d9aa673.why: 它直接检验了 LLM 社会仿真的可信度这一基础问题，用真人辨认实验给出了量化证据，对做舆论和社区仿真的研究者是重要的效度参考，同时也提示合成内容滥用的风险。

brief.question: LLM 能否生成足够逼真的社交媒体多人讨论，让读者分不清是真人还是 AI 写的，从而支撑在线社区仿真应用。
brief.setup: 从 Reddit 收集真实人类对话，再用 Llama 3 70B 和 GPT-4o 在相同话题下生成人工对话，由研究参与者并排阅读判断真伪。
brief.method: 收集真实 Reddit 对话作为参照，用两个 LLM 在同一话题上生成对话，再通过人类参与者的判别实验评估逼真度。
brief.findings: 参与者把 LLM 生成的对话误认为人类创作的比例为 39%；对 Llama 3 生成的对话，参与者只有 56% 的次数正确识别为 AI 生成，仅略高于随机水平。
brief.validation: 与真实 Reddit 人类对话做并排判别实验，由人类参与者评估，属于行为层面的验证，但材料未给出样本量等细节。
brief.limits: 材料指出 LLM 可被滥用于生成虚假社交媒体内容；未说明对话长度、话题范围和参与者规模等限制。

1390263b48ccc506.text: Due to the advantages of hypergraphs in modeling high-order relationships in complex systems, they have been applied to higher-order clustering, hypergraph neural networks and computer vision. These applications rely heavily on access to high-quality, large-scale real-world hypergraph data. Yet, compared to traditional pairwise graphs, real hypergraph datasets remain scarce in both scale and diversity. This shortage significantly limits the development and evaluation of advanced hypergraph learning algorithms. Therefore, how to quickly generate large-scale hypergraphs that conform to the characteristics of real networks is a crucial task that has not received sufficient attention. Motivated by recent advances in large language models (LLMs), particularly their capabilities in semantic reasoning, structured generation, and simulating human behavior, we investigate whether LLMs can facilitate hypergraph generation from a fundamentally new perspective. We introduce HyperLLM, a novel LLM-driven hypergraph generator that simulates the formation and evolution of hypergraphs through a multi-agent collaboration. The framework integrates prompts and structural feedback mechanisms to ensure that the generated hypergraphs reflect key real-world patterns. Extensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that HyperLLM achieves superior fidelity to structural and temporal hypergraph patterns, while requiring minimal statistical priors. Our findings suggest that LLM-based frameworks offer a promising new direction for hypergraph modeling.

121799532d4ad4cb.text: Large Language Models (LLMs) offer promising avenues for methodological and applied innovations in survey research by using synthetic respondents to emulate human answers and behaviour, potentially mitigating measurement and representation errors. However, the extent to which LLMs recover aggregate item distributions remains uncertain and downstream applications risk reproducing social stereotypes and biases inherited from training data. We evaluate the reliability of LLM-generated synthetic survey responses against ground-truth human responses from a Chilean public opinion probabilistic survey. Specifically, we benchmark 128 prompt-model-question triplets, generating 189,696 synthetic profiles, and pool performance metrics (i.e., accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score) in a meta-analysis across 128 question-subsample pairs to test for biases along key sociodemographic dimensions. The evaluation spans OpenAI's GPT family and o-series reasoning models, as well as Llama and Qwen checkpoints. Three results stand out. First, synthetic responses achieve excellent performance on trust items (F1-score and accuracy > 0.90). Second, GPT-4o, GPT-4o-mini and Llama 4 Maverick perform comparably on this task. Third, synthetic-human alignment is highest among respondents aged 45-59. Overall, LLM-based synthetic samples approximate responses from a probabilistic sample, though with substantial item-level heterogeneity. Capturing the full nuance of public opinion remains challenging and requires careful calibration and additional distributional tests to ensure algorithmic fidelity and reduce errors.
121799532d4ad4cb.abstract_zh: LLM 可以生成合成受访者来模拟人类的问卷回答，有望缓解调查中的测量误差和代表性误差，但它能在多大程度上还原题目的总体分布仍不确定，而且下游应用可能复现训练数据里的社会刻板印象和偏见。作者拿智利一份概率抽样的民意调查作为真值基准，评估 LLM 合成回答的可靠性。做法上，他们测试了 128 组提示-模型-题目三元组，生成 189,696 个合成档案，并在 128 个题目-子样本对上汇总准确率、精确率、召回率和 F1 分数，做元分析来检验关键人口学维度上的偏差。模型覆盖 OpenAI 的 GPT 系列和 o 系列推理模型，以及 Llama 和 Qwen 的检查点。结果有三点。第一，合成回答在信任类题目上表现很好，F1 分数和准确率都超过 0.90。第二，GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini 和 Llama 4 Maverick 在这个任务上表现相当。第三，合成回答与真人的对齐度在 45 至 59 岁受访者中最高。总体看，基于 LLM 的合成样本能近似概率样本的回答，但题目层面的异质性很大。作者认为，要捕捉民意的全部细微差别仍然困难，需要仔细的校准和额外的分布检验来保证算法保真度、降低误差。
121799532d4ad4cb.why: 它用一份真实的概率抽样调查做真值，系统比较了多家模型在合成问卷回答上的表现，给出了题目类型和年龄维度上的具体偏差证据，对想用 LLM 合成受访者替代真人样本的研究者是直接的可靠性参考。

brief.question: LLM 生成的合成问卷回答能否可靠地复现真实人类调查的回答分布，以智利公共意见概率抽样调查为测试场景。
brief.setup: 用多个模型生成合成受访者回答，覆盖 OpenAI 的 GPT 系列和 o 系列推理模型，以及 Llama 和 Qwen 的 checkpoint。共评估 128 个 prompt-model-question 三元组，生成 189,696 个合成档案。
brief.method: 将合成回答与智利公共意见概率调查的真实人类回答对比，在 128 个 question-subsample 对上汇总 accuracy、precision、recall 和 F1-score，做 meta-analysis，检验关键社会人口维度上的偏差。
brief.findings: 信任类问题（trust items）上合成回答表现最好，F1-score 和 accuracy 均超过 0.90。GPT-4o、GPT-4o-mini 和 Llama 4 Maverick 在该任务上表现相当。合成回答与人类回答的一致性在 45-59 岁受访者中最高。整体上 LLM 合成样本能近似概率样本的回答，但题目层面异质性很大。
brief.validation: 与智利公共意见概率调查的真实人类回答做基准对比，用 accuracy、precision、recall、F1-score 四个指标在 128 个 question-subsample 对上做 meta-analysis，并按社会人口维度检验偏差。
brief.limits: 题目层面异质性大，捕捉公共意见的全部细微之处仍有困难；下游应用可能复现训练数据中的社会刻板印象和偏差，需要仔细校准和额外的分布检验来保证算法保真度。

19dbb3367bb1c9d9.text: We present StockSim, an open-source simulation platform for systematic evaluation of large language models (LLMs) in realistic financial decision-making scenarios. Unlike previous toolkits that offer limited scope, StockSim delivers a comprehensive system that fully models market dynamics and supports diverse simulation modes of varying granularity. It incorporates critical real-world factors, such as latency, slippage, and order-book microstructure, that were previously neglected, enabling more faithful and insightful assessment of LLM-based trading agents. An extensible, role-based agent framework supports heterogeneous trading strategies and multi-agent coordination, making StockSim a uniquely capable testbed for NLP research on reasoning under uncertainty and sequential decision-making. We open-source all our code at https: //github.com/harrypapa2002/StockSim.

18fbdc202e1a6d88.text: Prior studies on deception in language-based AI agents typically assess whether the agent produces a false statement about a topic, or makes a binary choice prompted by a goal, rather than allowing open-ended deceptive behavior to emerge in pursuit of a longer-term goal. To fix this, we introduce Among Us, a sandbox social deception game where LLM-agents exhibit long-term, open-ended deception as a consequence of the game objectives. While most benchmarks saturate quickly, Among Us can be expected to last much longer, because it is a multi-player game far from equilibrium. Using the sandbox, we evaluate 18 proprietary and open-weight LLMs and uncover a general trend: models trained with RL are comparatively much better at producing deception than detecting it. We evaluate the effectiveness of methods to detect lying and deception: logistic regression on the activations and sparse autoencoders (SAEs). We find that probes trained on a dataset of "pretend you're a dishonest model:.." generalize extremely well out-of-distribution, consistently obtaining AUROCs over 95% even when evaluated just on the deceptive statement, without the chain of thought. We also find two SAE features that work well at deception detection but are unable to steer the model to lie less. We hope our open-sourced sandbox, game logs, and probes serve to anticipate and mitigate deceptive behavior and capabilities in language-based agents.
18fbdc202e1a6d88.abstract_zh:
以往对语言智能体欺骗行为的研究通常只考察模型是否就某话题说假话，或在目标提示下做二选一，没有让欺骗作为追求长期目标的开放式行为自然出现。作者为此引入 Among Us，一个社交欺骗游戏沙盒，LLM 智能体因游戏目标而表现出长期、开放式的欺骗。多数基准很快饱和，而 Among Us 是远离均衡的多人游戏，预计能维持更长时间的有效性。

作者用这个沙盒评测了 18 个专有和开放权重的 LLM，发现一个普遍趋势：经 RL 训练的模型在行骗上明显强于识骗。他们还评估了两类检测说谎与欺骗的方法：对激活值做逻辑回归，以及稀疏自编码器（SAE）。在“假装你是个不诚实的模型”这类数据上训练的探针，分布外泛化极好，即使只看欺骗性陈述本身、不看思维链，AUROC 也稳定超过 95%。他们还找到两个在欺骗检测上表现不错的 SAE 特征，但无法用它们引导模型少说谎。

作者开源了沙盒、游戏日志和探针，希望用于预判和缓解语言智能体的欺骗行为与能力。
18fbdc202e1a6d88.why: 它提供了一个远离均衡、不易饱和的开放式欺骗评测沙盒，加上能分布外泛化的探针和开源日志，是研究智能体欺骗检测的直接可用资源；RL 模型更会骗人这个结论也值得安全研究者注意。
